name: Heinrich Racker
shortBio: Austrian-Argentine psychoanalyst and musicologist who transformed clinical psychoanalysis by conceptualizing countertransference as the primary diagnostic instrument of the therapeutic process.
centralQuestion: How does the analyst's emotional countertransference reflect the patient's split internal object relations through concordant and complementary identifications?

keyWorks.title: Transference and Countertransference
keyWorks.description: Classic clinical monograph systematizing countertransference as a vital compass of the patient's internal object world.

keyWorks.title: The Countertransference Neurosis
keyWorks.description: Examines the interpsychic dynamics between the patient's neurosis and the analyst's unconscious responses.

keyWorks.title: Classical and Present Techniques of Psychoanalysis
keyWorks.description: Contrasts classical detached neutrality with modern intersubjective countertransference utilization.
